text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...A complete defeat. I got beaten so badly, there's no making excuses for it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd been workin' hard, but...
maybe it just wasn't enough...
choice_data_list: I gave it everything I had right now.
Let's use today's frustration as fuel and keep going

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I gave it everything I had.
There's no mistakin' that."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We just have to honestly accept the fact that this was the result despite all that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to get fired up again!
I'll figure out what I was missin'
and get my revenge for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm countin' on you for some top-notch coachin' too!
'Cause I am definitely winnin' the next race!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, Dad used to say that too.
'Stay bright and strong no matter how tough it gets.'"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Time to go train!
Let's fire ourselves up from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never give up!
Next time, I'm definitely taking 1st place!"
